title: coprosma patrickii
intro: Coprosma patrickii, commonly known as the New Zealand spinout or mirror bush, is a flowering plant native to New Zealand. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties that may aid in reducing stress and anxiety. The therapeutic actions of Coprosma patrickii include its potential to act as an anxiolytic, promoting relaxation and reducing symptoms of insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
